standard_prerequisites.name: The criteria for checking a property of morphisms of algebraic stacks after a smooth covering base change and after precomposing with a surjective etale morphism, and the characterisation of unramified morphisms of algebraic spaces by their diagonal
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 8481-8484, 8494-8505, 8530-8535) as pointers to results of this and other chapters
standard_prerequisites.use: Moves the etaleness of the diagonal up and down the presentation and turns the etaleness of a diagonal of an algebraic space into unramifiedness.

core_obligations: Unramified implies locally of finite type: since an unramified morphism is DM, the proof chooses a smooth presentation of the target and a surjective etale presentation of the source over it, and reads locally of finite type off the resulting unramified morphism of algebraic spaces (proof lines 8460-8468)

Unramified implies etale diagonal: the diagonal becomes, after the smooth base change, the diagonal of the presentation, and it suffices to prove etaleness there by the covering criterion (proof lines 8468-8484)

A further etale presentation of that diagonal exhibits it as a composite of etale morphisms with a surjective etale source, so etaleness descends along the etale localness on the source (proof lines 8485-8505)

Converse: assuming locally of finite type with etale diagonal the morphism is DM, so the same presentation applies; the diagonal of the presentation is etale by base change, whence the composite map from the etale presentation to the fibre product is etale, hence an open immersion because it is an etale monomorphism, and unramifiedness of the map of spaces follows from the diagonal criterion (proof lines 8507-8535)
proof_roadmap: (1)⇒(2)：非分歧 ⇒ DM，取满光滑 V → Y 与满 étale U → X ×_Y V，则 U → V 非分歧故局部有限型，于是 f 局部有限型；对角 Δ 在 V 的基变换下成为展示的对角，由覆盖判据可化到 X_V → X_V ×_V X_V；再用图 U → U ×_V U（竖直箭头 étale、上水平箭头由非分歧 morphism 的对角是开浸入）与「étale 在源上局部」得 X_V 的对角 étale。
(2)⇒(1)：局部有限型 + 对角 étale ⇒ DM（étale 蕴含非分歧），取同一展示；对角 étale 经基变换给出 X_V 的对角 étale，故 U → U ×_V U étale，作为 étale 单射即开浸入，于是 U → V 非分歧（代数空间对角判据），即 f 非分歧。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterises unramified morphisms of algebraic stacks as those which are locally of finite type and have etale diagonal (author lemma at source lines 8449-8457, label lemma-characterize-unramified). The proof (source lines 8459-8536) works with a DM presentation of the morphism in both directions: in the first direction it reads locally of finite type off an unramified morphism of algebraic spaces and proves etaleness of the diagonal after a smooth base change by exhibiting an etale presentation of that diagonal and descending along the etale localness on the source (proof lines 8485-8505); in the second direction it deduces from the etale diagonal that the map between the presenting spaces has etale diagonal, hence is an open immersion because etale monomorphisms are open immersions, which gives unramifiedness (proof lines 8507-8535). The two-way use of the presentation is the content. H3.
